Instructions

Preparation: Controlled torso-hinge variation: start light and move smoothly. Sit on the fixed bench; brace both feet with knees slightly bent.

1

Reach forward; keep both feet braced.

2

Keep knees soft and wrists straight.

3

Draw elbows back; bring chest upright.

4

Bring the handle toward your lower ribs.

5

Extend arms; hinge forward under control.

6

Keep feet braced; avoid bouncing.

Watch out

Use a small, comfortable torso hinge. Avoid bouncing or leaning far back to move the load.

COMMON MISTAKES

Jerking the handle or using excessive momentum.
Straightening the knees to drive the movement.
Pulling high toward the shoulders instead of the lower ribs.
